public_rationale: In a post published on June 15, 2024, Marcus wrote to expect more revisionism and downsized expectations through 2024 and 2025. The statement names no actor, measure, or threshold, so any test of it would rest on criteria we supplied. It is recorded and not scored.
limitations: On 22 June 2024 Marcus added an update to the post that, in his words, 'somewhat undermines the thesis of this essay': Kurzweil wrote to him that he still expects AGI by 2029.
This record does not assess whether AI leaders lowered their expectations in 2024 or 2025.
